files.description: The non-obvious rules of this repo: the vendored src/generic transit artifact and its intentional local patches, how the visual-regression references are generated, the packaging constraints (react external, --sbb-* token scopes), and the ban on silencing checks. Read this before judging whether a diff is idiomatic here.
How the Vitest browser-mode suite, the dockerized visual regression and the coverage gate work - including why a bare `npm test` diffs on screenshots off Linux.
What the library is, how consumers install and import it, and the supported build/lint/test commands.
The peer/dev dependency split (react, react-dom and sonner are peers), the exact-pinned playwright version that the container tag in the workflows must match, and the full script list.
The reference environment for the committed screenshots: the pinned Playwright image and PIXEL_REFERENCES=1, plus the lint/format/typecheck/build/test gate every PR must pass.
